thesis: Round 21 section 4c diagnostic, unranked and excluded from every correction over the ranked field. Run twice against two pins that differ only in binding: release-date bound, and naive reference-date bound. The gap between them is the direct measurement of the causality trap that section 2c exists to close. Gated on CPILFESL because it is the most revision-prone, longest-lagged series in the candidate set -- chosen because it is most likely to expose the trap, not because it is likely to look good. Not investment advice.
entry: close > sma(200) and ema(10) crosses_above ema(30) and macro(CPILFESL) > 300
